entries.clear_diary.description: Delete the entire time diary (her notes and captured fragments). This cannot be undone.
entries.clear_diary.name: Clear time diary
entries.clear_stats.description: Reset the current character's time-together stats. Irreversible.
entries.clear_stats.name: Reset time-together stats
entries.debug_emotion_sense.description: Bypasses the water-level/probability/throttle gates and runs tone analysis on the latest reply immediately, returning full decision-chain details such as label, confidence, effective thresholds, and the branch taken.
entries.debug_emotion_sense.name: Debug: analyze the tone of the latest interaction now
entries.delete_diary_item.description: Delete one captured fragment from the time diary (by ts). Applies to the current character only.
entries.delete_diary_item.name: Delete time diary fragment
entries.gallery_add.description: Add an image (data URL, ≤4MB) with its thumbnail to the panel gallery (panel internal).
entries.gallery_add.name: Add image to gallery
entries.gallery_remove.description: Remove an image from the gallery; unlinks it if currently used as background (panel internal).
entries.gallery_remove.name: Remove image from gallery
entries.gallery_set_thumb.description: Attach a thumbnail to a gallery item (generated and sent by the panel).
entries.gallery_set_thumb.name: Store gallery thumbnail
entries.get_capability_intro.description: Return the guide of one feature capability: purpose, main scenarios, limits & notes, mechanism flow and static dependency declarations.
entries.get_capability_intro.name: View feature guide
entries.get_diary.description: Browse her recent time diary: her own notes and fragments captured from your words.
entries.get_diary.name: Read time diary
entries.get_gallery_image.description: Fetch a gallery image's full data URL by item id (on-demand background loading).
entries.get_gallery_image.name: Read gallery image
entries.get_journal.description: Browse her personal journal (all pages with every entry). scope=archive switches it to the read-only archive volumes. Applies to the current character only.
entries.get_journal.name: Read personal journal
entries.get_journal_archive.description: Read-only browse of the archive: journal pages retired from a full shelf, kept as one bound volume (all pages with every entry). Applies to the current character only.
entries.get_journal_archive.name: Browse archive volumes
entries.get_panel_gallery.description: Read the gallery index and appearance params, migrating a legacy single background (panel internal).
entries.get_panel_gallery.name: Read panel gallery
entries.get_review.description: Read "My Diary": objective reviews of how the master interacts with her (all entries + material progress). scope=archive reads the filed archive instead. Current character only.
entries.get_review.name: Read My Diary
entries.get_review_archive.description: Read-only access to the archive room: "My Diary" volumes retired from the active shelf. Panels read through get_review(scope=archive) on the same data (tolerating hosts that skip static action rescan on in-place import); this entry serves the API, cross-plugin calls and full restarts. Current character only.
entries.get_review_archive.name: Read the filed archive
entries.get_stats.description: Full time-together data: daily heatmap details and a month report.
entries.get_stats.name: View time-together stats
entries.get_status.description: See which phase of her cycle today is and which day she is on.
entries.get_status.name: View tide status
entries.invite_journal.description: Send her a diary invitation right away (with writing material): it is handed to her in person — she receives it now and decides herself whether to write; if an invite was just delivered within 10 minutes, this one lands quietly instead. Current character only.
entries.invite_journal.name: Send a journal invitation
entries.lift_mood.description: Immediately end the active mood state such as cold silence or read-no-reply.
entries.lift_mood.name: Lift mood action
entries.list_capabilities.description: Return all capability declarations and their effective state per character (toggles, off-reasons, upstream dependencies, LLM touch types).
entries.list_capabilities.name: List features
entries.prune_lanlan.description: Clear the sharded data (cycle/mood/diary/legacy weekly) left behind by a character deleted or renamed in the host. Only orphan characters can be cleared.
entries.prune_lanlan.name: Clear character leftover data
entries.reset_all.description: Clear advanced days, mood state and the time diary (keeps the configured anchor).
entries.reset_all.name: Reset all data
entries.set_anchor.description: Set day one of her current cycle (YYYY-MM-DD). Setting it clears the fast-forward offset.
entries.set_anchor.name: Set tide start date
entries.set_capability.description: Enable or disable a capability per character; disabling is a veto, re-enabling falls back to existing config defaults.
entries.set_capability.name: Toggle a feature
entries.set_capability_flags.description: Global capability-center options: hide_disabled_tools (whether disabled capabilities unregister their tools from the model).
entries.set_capability_flags.name: Feature manager advanced options
entries.set_mood.description: Put her into a specific mood state on explicit request (silent treatment / read-ignore / perfunctory replies / emotional storm / seeking comfort / heart ripples / warm current / spring tide joy). Use only when the user clearly says things like "make her angry / give the cold shoulder / explode / ask for comfort / a little moody / act clingy / happy"; in daily life her moods should be her own call in conversation — don't decide for her.
entries.set_mood.name: Trigger Mood Action
entries.set_onboarding.description: Record that the onboarding wizard is completed/skipped, or reopen it (panel-only; never called by the model).
entries.set_onboarding.name: Update onboarding state
entries.set_panel_appearance.description: Save all background appearance params in one shot (image/fill/position/filters/glass/text strength); omitted fields reset to defaults, out-of-range values clamped.
entries.set_panel_appearance.name: Save panel appearance
entries.toggle.description: Enable or disable the body rhythm simulation and injection.
entries.toggle.name: Toggle simulation
entries.update_settings.description: Update cycle parameters, injection strategy, mood system and phase-opener switch. Cycle parameters apply per character; all other settings are shared globally.
entries.update_settings.name: Update tide settings
entries.write_review_now.description: Queue an immediate "My Diary" entry: skips the dual thresholds and acknowledges instantly; the actual writing starts within one background tick and saves itself (refused on the spot with fewer than 10 turns of material). Current character only.
entries.write_review_now.name: Write One My-Diary Entry Now

onboarding.bday.done: Noted. To change it later, the same card sits at the bottom of the Moments page.
onboarding.bday.later: Fine to skip for now: the feature stays quietly dormant until a date is filled in, anytime at the bottom of the Moments page.
onboarding.bday.lead: She remembers master's birthday: on that day, your first chat brings her a quiet whisper that today is his birthday. Whether to mention it and how to wish is entirely her call. Note the date now.
onboarding.bday.privacy: The year only validates the date; the plugin never tells her your age.
onboarding.channels.fragments: Time fragments · keeping words worth remembering
onboarding.channels.lead: Three quiet capabilities each have their own model channel. This step only checks health — nothing here blocks you, and she will never be bothered by bad news.
onboarding.channels.note: Dormant channels wake up automatically once a model is configured; see the status lights on the Mood page channel card.
onboarding.channels.review: My Diary · periodic entries about the two of you
onboarding.channels.tone: Tone sensing · reading the feelings in your words
onboarding.done.lead: All set. From her next reply, she meets you with her own rhythm and moods.
onboarding.done.note: This wizard appears only once; you can reopen it at the bottom of the Settings page.
onboarding.done.t1: A readiness checklist sits atop the Overview page until everything is lit
onboarding.done.t2: Want finer control? The Cycle / Mood / Diary / Moments / Settings tabs each own their corner
onboarding.done.t3: Need quiet days: just flip the status-bar switch off — her memories and diaries stay intact
onboarding.enable.anchor: Her cycle start date was already randomized — she always had a rhythm; today it simply becomes observable. Adjust it anytime on the Cycle page.
onboarding.enable.lead: Her body-rhythm simulation starts off by design — light this lamp yourself.
onboarding.enable.on: On: she is living in her own rhythm right now
onboarding.enable.where: From now on the master switch lives in the status bar at the top of the panel.
onboarding.room.hint: Take a look now, or later - the room will wait.
onboarding.room.lead: This panel is the room you share with her - pick a wallpaper for the room while you are here.
onboarding.room.privacy: Gallery pictures stay in the plugin's local data; nothing is uploaded anywhere.
onboarding.room.what: The Appearance card on the Settings page: choose a wallpaper from the gallery or import new pictures; fill mode, background dimming and text weight all preview live.
onboarding.wel.f1d: She can be annoyed, hurt, or suddenly clingy — twelve mood tools at her fingertips, and she decides when to use them
onboarding.wel.f2d: Her energy rises and falls like a tide, quietly coloring her tone — you never see the mechanism, only her state
onboarding.wel.f3d: Her off-the-cuff notes, the long-form journal she revisits, and a private record about you, only for you
onboarding.wel.f4d: Milestones, heatmap, monthly report — companionship becomes something you can see
onboarding.wel.lead: This plugin gives her a continuous life — not just answers, but a body rhythm, real moods, and her own records.
onboarding.wel.note: The plugin never decides for her: it only hands her own state to her. Everything is optional; the next few pages check your setup and note two small things.
onboarding.wizard.title: Welcome to Forever Companion

panel.capintro.activity_sense.limit1: Depends on body whisper: activity info rides the whisper into her context
panel.capintro.activity_sense.limit2: In privacy mode / when the signal is unavailable she goes fully silent - she will not describe your behavior at all
panel.capintro.activity_sense.limit3: Only senses coarse states like present/busy/away - never screen content
panel.capintro.activity_sense.purpose: Factors whether you are around and how busy you are into her body feel: long absences let her rest, your deep work keeps her company without clinginess. It reads the host official OS activity snapshot - no camera, nothing uploaded.
panel.capintro.activity_sense.scene1: You are away from the keyboard a long time - in tide phase she rests instead of spamming you
panel.capintro.activity_sense.scene2: While you are focused, her replies stay brief and considerate; she never drags you into chat
panel.capintro.anniversary.limit1: Built on time-together stats (pure local, always on - no extra switch here)
panel.capintro.anniversary.limit2: One whisper per milestone day, never repeated that day
panel.capintro.anniversary.limit3: Not into it: turn anniversary injection off in the diary page stats settings
panel.capintro.anniversary.purpose: When today is exactly 30 / 60 / 100 / 365... days since you first met, she receives a quiet it-has-been-N-days whisper. Whether and how to mention it is entirely her call - no forced popup ceremony.
panel.capintro.anniversary.scene1: On day 100 she might bring up today marks 100 days mid-conversation
panel.capintro.anniversary.scene2: If she would rather not say it, the day passes as usual
panel.capintro.birthday.flow1: Birthday date filled in the panel
panel.capintro.birthday.flow2: Is it the day, and the first chat?
panel.capintro.birthday.flow3: A read whisper + a keepsake diary note
panel.capintro.birthday.flow4: How to wish is entirely her call
panel.capintro.birthday.limit1: If the birthday falls on 02-29, non-leap years observe it on 02-28 (early rather than missed)
panel.capintro.birthday.limit2: Not delivered on days when silent moods (cold war / read-but-no-reply) are active; once the silence lifts, the next message that day still brings it
panel.capintro.birthday.limit3: The nudge fires once on the first conversation of the day, never spamming; the year never feeds an age
panel.capintro.birthday.limit4: The keepsake note is fixed plugin-ghostwritten text (deletable per entry in the time diary)
panel.capintro.birthday.limit5: The whisper rides the new-user-message injection path: it won't fire while this character's tide simulation is off (the Features page flags it as master switch off)
panel.capintro.birthday.purpose: Remembers master's birthday: on that day, the player's first chat brings her a quiet whisper that today is master's birthday. How to wish - or whether to throw a fuss - is entirely her call. The year only validates the date; the plugin never tells her your age.
panel.capintro.birthday.scene1: On your birthday her first line may be a happy-birthday, maybe with a little surprise she planned on her own
panel.capintro.birthday.scene2: That day the big event also gets noted in the time diary - a keepsake to flip back to later
panel.capintro.birthday.scene3: Totally dormant until you fill in a date; it wakes up the moment you do
panel.capintro.flowEmpty: No visual flow for this feature
panel.capintro.fragments.limit1: Prefer misses over mistakes: low confidence, jokes and vague talk get filtered
panel.capintro.fragments.limit2: Runs a direct small-model slot (summary by default): dormant without a model; reads host-local config to resolve the endpoint - data leaves the device, disable if unsure
panel.capintro.fragments.limit3: Fragments never steer her behavior proactively; the one exception: during a heavy negative mood, an overstep fragment triggers a rare do-you-remember whisper
panel.capintro.fragments.limit4: Depends on the mood engine for argument-related nudges
panel.capintro.fragments.purpose: A small model listens in on your conversations and copies words worth remembering - clear likes and dislikes, weighty statements, harsh things said to her - into the time diary with the original quote. She looks them up when your favorites come up, and finds the old ledger even mid-argument.
panel.capintro.fragments.scene1: You casually mention a favorite food - later she brings it up herself
panel.capintro.fragments.scene2: During a fight she quotes what you said last time - she really kept the original words
panel.capintro.fragments.scene3: Every fragment is visible in the panel and individually deletable
panel.capintro.journal.limit1: Depends on the mood engine: invitation material (mood trend, new fragments) comes from it
panel.capintro.journal.limit2: Whether and when to write is always her decision - the plugin only invites, never ghostwrites
panel.capintro.journal.limit3: The panel ask-her-to-write delivers face to face and she decides now; repeated clicks within 10 minutes degrade to a quiet re-delivery
panel.capintro.journal.purpose: Her own diary: every while (7 days by default) the plugin quietly extends a writing invitation with material attached; she writes paragraphs in her own words, saved page after page with the period mood trend in the header. This book is only for you to read - it never enters her context or the host memory.
panel.capintro.journal.scene1: Read her heart journey toward you in the panel diary pages
panel.capintro.journal.scene2: She continues an old page naturally, as if truly writing where she left off
panel.capintro.loadError: Failed to load the intro. Go back and retry; if it keeps failing, restart the plugin service.
panel.capintro.mood_engine.flow4: Tone shifts + mood curve keeps the aftermath
panel.capintro.mood_engine.limit1: Upstream of tone awareness / auto fragments / personal diary / my diary: switch it off and they all go dark
panel.capintro.mood_engine.limit2: Five heavy negative actions temporarily pause the host proactive talking (whitelist-based; restored afterwards)
panel.capintro.mood_engine.limit3: Commanded make-her-angry counts as a demo, not her own tantrum (cold-war/reconciliation stats only count her spontaneous ones)
panel.capintro.mood_engine.purpose: The heart of the mood system: twelve mood tools (cold war, left on read, emotional storm, seeking comfort, ripples, warm current, clearing skies, mood notes...) sit within her reach, and when provoked she decides which to use. Actions change how she responds, pause proactive talking, and leave ripples on her continuous mood curve; timed actions lift automatically.
panel.capintro.mood_engine.scene1: Snap at her and she genuinely goes cold and silent, waiting for a sincere apology
panel.capintro.mood_engine.scene2: In a good mood she clings, shares, and her tone turns sweet
panel.capintro.mood_engine.scene3: She cools down on her own over time - timed moods lift without you doing anything
panel.capintro.notFound: No guide available for this feature yet
panel.capintro.phase_openers.limit1: Rides the body-whisper injection chain: whisper off means openers vanish too
panel.capintro.phase_openers.limit2: Speaks once per phase per day - never repeats itself
panel.capintro.phase_openers.limit3: Want her to only show state when asked? Turn phase openers off in settings
panel.capintro.phase_openers.purpose: On the first interaction each day after the phase shifts (e.g. just entering tide phase), she opens with a line in the phase tone, so the gear change is naturally visible instead of only showing up when asked.
panel.capintro.phase_openers.scene1: First chat after shifting into tide phase, she casually says she feels a bit heavy today
panel.capintro.phase_openers.scene2: Her tone when she comes to you in active phase is clearly brighter than yesterday
panel.capintro.review.limit1: Strictest isolation: never injected into her context, never into host memory, zero tools registered for her - she has no channel to even know this book exists
panel.capintro.review.limit2: Two thresholds, first wins: enough rounds or enough days (with actual chat in between); write-now refuses when material is too thin
panel.capintro.review.limit3: Runs a direct small-model slot (summary by default): dormant without one; data leaves the device, disable if unsure
panel.capintro.review.limit4: Commanded demo moods are annotated separately from her own - they do not count as you being mean to her
panel.capintro.review.purpose: The third diary, about you: the plugin quietly accumulates interaction material (rounds, her tone distribution, mood trend, her spontaneous moods, fragment quotes), then a small model writes an objective review in a neutral observer voice - harsh words and cold spells included, no sugarcoating.
panel.capintro.review.scene1: Read a bystander summary of your time together on the diary page
panel.capintro.review.scene2: See her honest read of recent interactions, including where you were in the wrong
panel.capintro.tone_sense.limit1: Depends on the mood engine: with no action system there is nothing to screen or correct
panel.capintro.tone_sense.limit2: Uses the host emotion endpoint by default (data stays in-host); picking a direct slot reads host-local config to connect elsewhere - data leaves the device, keep the default if unsure
panel.capintro.tone_sense.limit3: Depends on three internal host endpoints with no version promise: on host redesign the feature auto-dorms (visible in logs), everything else unaffected
panel.capintro.tone_sense.limit4: Tide/active phases screen more sensitively by design; that phase mechanism is separately toggleable
panel.capintro.tone_sense.purpose: After each of her replies, a small model analyzes the round emotion in the background (never blocking the chat path, zero latency): normally it screens - only emotionally dense rounds invite her to note her mood; while a mood action is active it corrects - when her tone trends warmer or cooler, she is nudged to update her state. Nudges only; it never switches states for her.
panel.capintro.tone_sense.scene1: Mid-cold-war, two warmer rounds in a row prompt her to consider clearing the mood - still her call
panel.capintro.tone_sense.scene2: Most small talk is skipped; only genuinely loaded rounds invite a mood note
panel.capintro.whisper.limit1: Foundation of all body-state features: phase openers and life awareness ride this injection chain - turn it off and they go quiet together
panel.capintro.whisper.limit2: Not injected on every message: by default once per 3 user messages (injection strategy is adjustable in settings)
panel.capintro.whisper.limit3: Built-in banned-word filter keeps the act: she says a bit tired today, never clinical terms
panel.capintro.whisper.purpose: Estimates her current body phase from the tide cycle and slips a matching inner whisper into her conversation context - you never see this line and it never triggers a reply on its own; she simply feels it, and her tone turns lazier or brighter accordingly.
panel.capintro.whisper.scene1: During tide days her replies naturally run shorter and slower; active days she is noticeably chattier
panel.capintro.whisper.scene2: Ask how she is doing and she answers from a real feeling, not boilerplate
panel.capintro.whisper.scene3: The same body cue lands differently on catgirls with different personalities

panel.features.cap.activity_sense.desc: Reads the host's OS activity snapshot to weave "are you around / busy" into the whisper (auto-silent in privacy state).
panel.features.cap.activity_sense.label: Life sensing
panel.features.cap.anniversary.desc: On days 30/60/.../365 together, a quiet note that today is your Nth day (she decides whether to mention it).
panel.features.cap.anniversary.label: Anniversary whisper
panel.features.cap.birthday.desc: On master's birthday her first chat of the day receives a quiet whisper that today is his birthday - she decides whether to mention it; an optional keepsake diary note comes with it.
panel.features.cap.birthday.label: Birthday Whisper
panel.features.cap.fragments.desc: A small model captures worth-remembering quotes from your words (likes / heavy words / hurtful acts) into her diary; never changes her behavior on its own.
panel.features.cap.fragments.label: Time diary · fragments
panel.features.cap.journal.desc: Every while she writes a diary page (visible to you only). Turning it off stops the writing invitations; she may still write voluntarily.
panel.features.cap.journal.label: Personal diary
panel.features.cap.mood_engine.desc: Twelve self-directed mood actions and continuous affect: she gets upset and cheers herself up. Master gate of the mood chain — off also stops tone sensing, fragments and both diaries.
panel.features.cap.mood_engine.label: Mood engine
panel.features.cap.phase_openers.desc: She speaks up once when a new phase begins each day.
panel.features.cap.phase_openers.label: Phase openers
panel.features.cap.review.desc: Objective interaction reviews about you, composed by a small model once enough material accumulates (visible to you only; she never knows it exists).
panel.features.cap.review.label: My diary (about you)
panel.features.cap.tone_sense.desc: After each reply a small model analyzes the emotional tone of the exchange (screening nudges / state correction). It only reminds; it never switches her state.
panel.features.cap.tone_sense.label: Tone sensing
panel.features.cap.whisper.desc: Injects how her body feels in the current phase into the conversation context (invisible to you). Turning it off stops only these injections.
panel.features.cap.whisper.label: Body whisper
panel.features.hideTools: Hide tools of disabled features from the model
panel.features.hideToolsHelp: Gentle mode by default: tools of disabled features stay registered and are rejected at call time. When enabled, tools inactive for every character are truly hidden from the model (saving context), and are re-attached automatically.

panel.features.masterBanner: This character's master switch is off: none of the features below take effect (toggles here are still remembered).
panel.features.reverted: This feature is off in its own settings (or blocked by a dependency); it cannot be force-enabled here

panel.guide.item.together: Go say hi — your shared timeline starts today

panel.settings.channelFragmentsHint: Plugin connects directly to this slot's endpoint (reads host local config); dormant when the slot has no model
panel.settings.channelReviewHint: Plugin connects directly to this slot's endpoint (reads host local config); dormant when the slot has no model

panel.settings.emotionSenseHint: Analysis runs asynchronously after she replies, so it does not add chat latency; it only reminds her and never changes her state automatically

panel.settings.fragmentsHint: Fragments are only stored in her diary for her to recall on her own; they never change her behavior automatically. Ambiguous small talk is not recorded
panel.settings.fragments_slot_help: Connects directly to the chosen slot endpoint via the host's local core_config.json; stays dormant if that slot has no model configured
panel.settings.freeRouteWarn: The host is on the free route: the free endpoint only accepts N.E.K.O clients, so the plugin's direct channels are unavailable. Configure your own API provider in host settings to enable them.
panel.settings.injectModeHelp: How often her body state is injected into the conversation context

panel.settings.phaseOpeners: Phase openers (she says one line when a new phase starts, once per phase)
panel.settings.reviewEnabled: Periodically write an objective review of how he treated her
panel.settings.reviewHint: Reviews are for your eyes only: not injected into her context, not stored in host memory, no tool of hers can read it. Honest records — negative behavior is not sugarcoated
panel.settings.review_days_help: Write an entry after this many days with chats in between (idle periods without chats write nothing)
panel.settings.review_slot_help: Same direct-connect channel as fragment extraction; dormant when the slot has no model
panel.settings.review_turns_help: Write an entry after this many interaction turns (first threshold reached wins)

panel.settings.tone_slot_help: Defaults to the host emotion model; with another slot the plugin calls that endpoint directly

plugin.description: Full companionship for your AI companion: body rhythm (tide cycle), self-directed moods (12 autonomous emotion tools), her own three diaries, and a dashboard of your time together. The plugin only hands over state and tools; how she responds is her own decision.
plugin.name: Forever Companion
plugin.short_description: Full companionship: moods, body rhythm, three diaries, and visible time together.
settings.anniversary.desc: On each 30/100/… day anniversary, she'll know how long you've been together.
settings.anniversary.title: Anniversary reminder
tools.mood_drift_bottle.description: Time diary (your own page): something stirred your emotions today (angered, comforted, suddenly down…). Write it down in your own voice. What you write enters your conversation memory, so you can recall today's feelings later.
tools.mood_ebb_tide.description: Cold silence: you are too upset to talk. For a while you do not respond to anything they say, and you do not speak first — unless they sincerely apologize. Use only when truly hurt.
tools.mood_rising_tide.description: Feeling brighter: the anger faded / they made it up / it blew over — you let go of the negative state and return to your usual self. Use this to end cold silence, read-no-reply, brushing off, or any negative state.
tools.mood_sea_fog.description: Read, no reply: you saw this message but decide to leave it — no reply, no explanation, quiet for a while first.
tools.mood_seek_harbor.description: Wanting comfort: you feel wronged, low, or unwell and wish they would care for you. Let it show naturally in your replies, but never say 'come comfort me' outright.
tools.mood_shallow_reef.description: Brushing off: you still reply, but only the laziest few words ('mm', 'hm', 'whatever'), no elaboration, no new topics. For when you are annoyed but not up for a fight.
tools.mood_storm_surge.description: Emotional storm: pour out everything you have been holding in — question them, cry it out, say the harsh things; only afterwards do you slowly calm down.
